# DBR 5-Week Fast Start

> The DBR 5-Week Fast Start (dreamsfaststart.com) is a free, self-paced training system from Dreams Business Resources that takes new partners from day one to their first commissions in the financial services and B2B marketplace. It covers the DREAMS Score business intelligence report, prospecting and warm-market scripts, marketing systems, AI tools and agents, and the full DBR compensation plan, with a 10-question knowledge check at the end of each week.

## What the training covers

The system is organized into five weekly modules plus supporting resources. Week 1 builds foundations: the DBR story, the DREAMS Score, and getting set up in the back office. Week 2 covers prospecting: building a warm list, referral conversations, and first appointments. Week 3 covers marketing systems that generate inbound interest. Week 4 covers advanced scripts and email follow-up sequences. Week 5 covers AI tools and agents that let one person operate like a full team. Additional tabs include a Resources hub with an income calculator, a full Prospecting system, a Marketing library, the Compensation Plan, and a $100,000 Growth Plan.

## The DREAMS Score

The DREAMS Score is a complimentary AI-powered business intelligence report that examines six areas of a business: Debt & Corporate Funding, Retirement & 401(k), Expense Reduction, Asset Optimization, Money & Tax Credits, and Security & Protection. It uncovers hidden tax credits (R&D, FICA tip), payroll savings, group health overpayments, technology and energy savings, funding options, and growth opportunities — at no cost and no obligation to the business owner.

## How partners earn

DBR partners introduce business owners to money-finding solutions and earn commissions plus compounding residual renewals. A single client with 100 employees can generate roughly $1,200–$1,950 per month in recurring income, and renewals continue for the life of every contract.

## About the publisher

Dreams Business Resources (DBR) builds effective virtual distribution teams in the financial services and B2B marketplace using online tools, training, and cutting-edge technology. Motto: One Relationship. Multiple Revenue Streams. Infinite Possibilities. Led by Mike Hinsvark, Senior Agency Partner.
